about.title: About
about.subtitle: About Me
about.bio: I'm a Developer passionate about technology and building meaningful digital products. With experience in full-stack web development, I'm always seeking new challenges and learning opportunities.
about.experience_1_description: Leading development of scalable web applications using Next.js, TypeScript, and cloud services. Mentoring junior developers and establishing best practices.
about.experience_2_description: Built and maintained multiple client projects using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Collaborated with design teams to deliver pixel-perfect UIs.
about.experience_3_description: Started career building responsive websites and learning modern JavaScript frameworks. Contributed to open-source projects.
about.education_description: Graduated with honors. Focused on software engineering and web technologies.

projects.project_1_description: Personal portfolio website built with modern technologies. Features dark mode, i18n, animations, and responsive design.
projects.project_2_description: Full-stack task management application with real-time updates, team collaboration, and intuitive drag-and-drop interface.
projects.project_3_description: Real-time weather dashboard with interactive charts, location search, and 7-day forecast. Integrates multiple weather APIs.
